name: 王謹誠
objective:
本課程在應用計算方法來解決工程問題，重點將放在理解各種數值方法背後的基本概念。
This course is to teach you how to apply computational methodologies to solve engineering problems when no analytical solution exists. 
Emphasis will be placed on understanding the basic concepts behind the various numerical methods.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week01 Matlab Fundamentals  
Week02 Introduction to Numerical Methods
Week03 Introduction to Numerical Methods
Week04 教師節
Week05 Root Finding
Week06 Root Finding
Week07 System of Equations
Week08 校慶慶祝大會暨園遊會補假 
Week09 Midterm
Week10 Interpolation Methods  
Week11 Interpolation Methods
Week12 Approximation of Functions 
Week13 Approximation of Functions
Week14 Numerical Differentiation and Integration 
Week15 Initial Value Problems 
Week16 Final Exam 期末考
Week17 Flexible Learning
Week18 Flexible Learning
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          (1) 第 17 週: 安裝學習使用計算流體力學軟體
(2) 第 18 週: 線上報告 
Learning CFD using ANSYS Fluent to solve laminar pipe flow.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v = KWP0nl_Qf - 0
Goals: Install and test your code, and make a report to explain the process below.
1) Learning goals and the related industrial problem. 
2) Problem specification, and then explain from the Pre-analysis to the Numerical Solution.
3) Explain numerical results, and verification as well as validation.
4) Summary and future works.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          安裝學習使用計算流體力學軟體來解決工程應用問題, 並透過報告呈現結果，在第 18 週進行線上報告及評分。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          線上報告成績佔學期成績 10%
